values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bodilake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Bodi Lake: nightly fee $20; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch for small craft, kayaks and canoes on the north side of the lake, to the left as you enter (no-wake rules); carry-in access from some campsites. ORVs may only enter and leave the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bodilake ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well', 'There is a boat launch on the north side of the lake for small watercrafts, kayaks and canoes', 'No-wake rules are in place', 'Carry-in access is located at the boat launch or directly from some of the campsites', 'ORV use is allowed in the campground to enter and exit only'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bodilake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 12 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording). No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bodilake ('There are 12 sites for tent and small trailer use', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (12 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Several sites right on the lake.  --AWH
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 12 tent/small-trailer sites on the northwest side of Bodi Lake, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, small-craft boat launch, first-come only (confirmed), 15-day max (now on the entry). Season left as recorded (manual, table's Nov 30 - May 1 closure) though the campground page says open all year (flag). --AWH 'several sites right on the lake' kept; 'First come first served' dropped as redundant.
